plugins.name: arckit-uk-finance
plugins.displayName: ArcKit UK Financial Services Payments Overlay
plugins.description: UK Financial Services Payments Overlay for ArcKit — 4 commands for established UK Payment Service Providers, E-Money Institutions, and Payment Institutions: PSD2 SCA-RTS exemption design, EMI/PI safeguarding assessment, FCA Consumer Duty board report, and Critical Third Parties dependency assessment. Recipe: uk-fs-payments. Requires arckit core plugin. EXPERIMENTAL — community-maintained, no named domain co-maintainer at launch.

commands.name: uk-fs-consumer-duty
commands.description: [COMMUNITY] Generate an FCA Consumer Duty annual Board Report — customer outcomes evidence pack across the four outcomes (Products & Services, Price & Value, Consumer Understanding, Consumer Support), price & value assessment, target market assessment, fair-value framework.
headings: Step 3 — Read the templates and rendering partials
Step 6 — Generate the vulnerable customer cohort summary

commands.name: uk-fs-ctp-dependency
commands.description: [COMMUNITY] Generate a Critical Third Parties (CTP) dependency assessment — register of designated CTPs the firm relies on (cloud hyperscalers, payment networks, BaaS providers), materiality assessment per provider, resilience testing plan including exit and substitution drills (BoE/PRA/FCA PS24/16).
headings: Step 3 — Read the templates and rendering partials
Step 5 — Identify designated CTPs in scope

commands.name: uk-fs-safeguarding
commands.description: [COMMUNITY] Generate an EMI / PI safeguarding assessment — method statement (segregation vs insurance vs guarantee), designated safeguarding bank/insurance arrangements, reconciliation cadence + sign-off chain, end-to-end client-funds flow, audit plan aligned to FCA REP-CRIM expectations.
headings: Step 3 — Read the templates and rendering partials
Step 5 — Generate the safeguarding method statement

commands.name: uk-fs-sca-rts
commands.description: [COMMUNITY] Generate a UK PSD2 SCA-RTS exemption design document — exemption applicability matrix, transaction risk analysis (TRA) thresholds, fraud monitoring framework, and per-exemption decision rationale.
headings: Step 3 — Read the templates and rendering partials
Step 5 — Generate the exemption applicability matrix
